name: unquarantine
title: Unquarantine
description: 一键解除未签名 App 的 Gatekeeper 隔离，免去在系统设置里反复找 Open Anyway
author: jack

commands.name: unquarantine-latest
commands.title: Unquarantine Latest App
commands.subtitle: Gatekeeper
commands.description: 取 24 小时内下载、真正被 Gatekeeper 拦住的那个 App，确认后直接解除，无需 Touch ID

commands.name: open-anyway
commands.title: Open Anyway
commands.subtitle: Gatekeeper
commands.description: 打开安全设置并定位到被阻止的 App，Open Anyway 由你自己点

commands.name: unquarantine-apps
commands.title: Unquarantine Apps
commands.subtitle: Gatekeeper
commands.description: 列出会被 Gatekeeper 拦住的 App，一键解除隔离并打开；可切换查看全部带隔离属性的项

commands.name: unquarantine-finder-selection
commands.title: Unquarantine Finder Selection
commands.subtitle: Gatekeeper
commands.description: 对 Finder 中选中的文件/App 解除隔离

commands.name: open-security-settings
commands.title: Open Security Settings
commands.subtitle: Gatekeeper
commands.description: 直接跳到「系统设置 › 隐私与安全性 › Security」分区，无需滚动

preferences.name: openAfterUnquarantine
preferences.title: 解除后自动打开
preferences.label: Unquarantine Latest App 解除隔离后直接启动该 App

preferences.name: extraPaths
preferences.title: 额外扫描目录
preferences.description: 除 /Applications、~/Applications、~/Downloads 外要扫描的目录，用英文逗号分隔

preferences.name: adhocSign
preferences.title: 解除隔离后重新签名
preferences.label: 对 App 执行 codesign --sign -（ad-hoc）
preferences.description: 解决部分 App 去掉隔离属性后仍提示「已损坏」的问题
